description: Narrow the finalized-invoice guard so a paid invoice can accept more payment
expected_violation: A paid invoice accepts an additional payment instead of being rejected
violation_scenario: pay_invoice(Invoice(id='i1', status='paid', balance_due=0.0), 10.0) decrements balance to -10.0 instead of raising.
rationale: Dropping 'paid' from the guarded statuses is the smallest change that lets a finalized (paid) invoice accept payment.
